items.label: text
items.text: The alkenes are a homologous series of hydrocarbons which contain a carbon-carbon double bond. The C=C bond is the functional group of the alkenes.

items.label: text
items.text: The first three members of the alkene series are shown in Table 25.1.

items.label: table
items.text:
Table 25.1 The first three alkenes

| Name      | Molecular formula   | Empirical formula   | Structural formula   | Displayed formula        |
|-----------|---------------------|---------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|
| ethene    | C2H4                | CH2                 | CH2=CH{2             | H H C C H H              |
| propene   | C3H6                | CH2                 | CH2=CHCH₃            | H H C C C —H H H H       |
| but-1-ene | C{H8                | CH2                 | CH2=CHCH2CH3         | H H H H C C C —C-H H H H |

items.label: text
items.text: It is not possible to have an alkene with one carbon atom because alkenes must contain a C=C group so you need a minimum of two carbon atoms.
